description: Change a launched ChatGPT ad’s lifetime budget. First read get_chatgpt_ads. State the new total and additional reservation/fee and obtain approval. Additional charge = max(0, new budget - fundedBudgetCents) plus that increase × serviceFeePct (fee rounded to minor units). Send that exact additionalChargeCents and the current expectedBudgetCents. A reduction retains the existing reservation and paid fees until settlement. On an uncertain result reuse requestKey and the identical target; do not invent a fresh key.

additionalChargeCents.description: Exact additional charge in minor units, computed as this tool’s description says.

budgetCents.description: Lifetime media budget in wallet minor units (50000 means 500.00). Read the currency with get_chatgpt_ads.

campaignId.description: oriiion campaign ID returned by these tools, never an external account/ad ID.

confirmed.description: True only when the user has approved the stated money terms and shared advertiser identity.

expectedBudgetCents.description: The campaign’s current budgetCents from get_chatgpt_ads; rejects the change if it moved.

requestKey.description: Generate one UUID for this operation and reuse it on retries.

name: update_chatgpt_ad_budget
